resources.string: This activity requires the following permissions:
Bookplayer needs [Read Audio] permission (or set [Copy File] option).

[Read Audio] permission was denied. 

Click [App Info] to activate permissions manually. 

Or 

Click [Options] to activate app 'Copy File internally' option. 
Then, your audio files will be copied inside Bookplayer internal memory and you won't need any permission to read them.
Spectrum visualizer will not be displayed. [record audio] permission has been denied.

BookPlayer can not ask again for an already denied permission. 
You can bypass by clicking -Retry-. 
That will open the application settings on the device. 

Then go in "Permissions" section and manually allow "Microphone".
Permissions are not granted, cannot play audio.
